title: EEF CNA OSV extensions
description: The shape of every database_specific and ecosystem_specific object in an EEF CNA OSV record: the top-level database_specific, affected[].database_specific, and affected[].ecosystem_specific of Hex packages. The OSV schema (https://ossf.github.io/osv-schema/) defines these fields and leaves their contents to the database and the ecosystem.

$schema.description: URL of the schema version that the object conforms to.

cwe_ids.description: CWE IDs from the problemTypes of the CVE record. Top-level database_specific only.

capec_ids.description: CAPEC IDs from the impacts of the CVE record. Top-level database_specific only.

cpe_ids.description: CPE 2.3 names from all affected entries of the CVE record. Top-level database_specific only.

affected.description: The affected source files, modules and routines of one affected[] entry. affected[].database_specific and affected[].ecosystem_specific only. The values come from the programFiles, modules and programRoutines fields of the matching CVE affected[] entry.

program_files.description: Affected source files. Paths are relative to the root of the package or repository that the affected[] entry describes.

modules.description: Affected modules, by the name the language uses for them.

program_routines.description: Affected functions. Erlang and Elixir functions use Erlang notation module:function/arity.
